subject: QBR readiness: cascade items, exec asks, and closure plan
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR readiness: cascade items, exec asks, and closure plan

Team —

Thanks for a productive sync this morning. Per our QBR checklist we have three high-impact exec asks that need owners and firm delivery dates before EOW so we can bundle the QBR packet for review: 

1) SLA and incident examples for Dedicated customers (exec ask: 99.95 demo scenarios) — owner: Marcus (propose 2027-04-16)
2) Cost delta analysis for quantized vs non-quantized serving on representative workload — owner: Grace (propose 2027-04-15)
3) Mutual action plan version for Acme (legal + procurement-ready) — owner: Marissa (propose 2027-04-18)

I've attached the working QBR checklist and a draft MAP we started with Sales. Please do the following by EOD Thursday: confirm the delivery date, list any blockers, and add any slides/attachments to the Drive folder linked below. I'll consolidate on Friday morning and circulate the packet to Exec for Saturday review.

Attachments: qbr_prep_checklist.xlsx, mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-Prep-2027
HubSpot: hubspot:deal:ACME-2027-42

Small favors: if an item needs a scope change (e.g., narrow example set for SLA), call it out explicitly so I can negotiate scope with the exec owner.

Thanks —
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Program Ops, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR readiness: cascade items, exec asks, and closure plan

Naomi —

Thanks for the clear ask. I'll take SLA examples. Quick status and ask:
- Scope: I'll produce three real incident vignettes (P1/P2) that show detection, route-to-fallback, and postmortem summary; one vignette will be a cross-region fallback.
- Blocker: I need the final SLA language legal is considering (we have two alternate drafts); if we use Draft B I can compress to 04/16 but Draft A will push to 04/18.
- Deliverable: One slide per vignette + appendix with timestamps/metrics.

Action: Naomi, can you ping Legal or share the two drafts you referenced? Otherwise I'll prepare for Draft B and mark contingency.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Serving Runtime
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR readiness: cascade items, exec asks, and closure plan

On Tue, Apr 13, 2027 at 11:05 AM Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Naomi —
> 
> Thanks for the clear ask. I'll take SLA examples. Quick status and ask:
> - Scope: I'll produce three real incident vignettes (P1/P2) that show detection, route-to-fallback, and postmortem summary; one vignette will be a cross-region fallback.
> - Blocker: I need the final SLA language legal is considering (we have two alternate drafts); if we use Draft B I can compress to 04/16 but Draft A will push to 04/18.
> - Deliverable: One slide per vignette + appendix with timestamps/metrics.

Folks — I'm on the cost delta analysis. Early note: our benchmark set for this customer will likely need a narrower token distribution than our public tests (Acme runs many short prompts). I'll run the quantized runs on dedicated and hosted variants and produce both an absolute cost-per-1000 tokens and a percentage delta. I should have a first-pass spreadsheet by Friday (04/16).

Two asks for Naomi/Prod:
- Can we confirm the representative workload sample for Acme (I saw a snippet in the Drive but need the final CSV)?
- If we plan to show lower-latency tradeoffs, I need permission to include a short synthetic p95 test we run in the infra lab.

I'll post the CSV and initial numbers to the Drive by EOD Friday.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, katie@acme.com
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 18 Apr 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: QBR readiness: cascade items, exec asks, and closure plan

Forwarding to Acme so they see the revised MAP milestone and our proposed packet timeline. Marissa, please attach the procurement-ready MAP and redlines you plan to send to legal. Marcus and Grace — Acme asked for targeted examples that reflect their short-prompt distribution (see Grace's note). Can we confirm the following today so I can lock the QBR packet?

- Marcus: SLA vignette final draft (target 2027-04-18 15:00 PT)
- Grace: Cost delta first-pass spreadsheet + sample CSV (target 2027-04-16 18:00 PT)
- Marissa: MAP (procurement-ready) and any anticipated redlines (target 2027-04-18 12:00 PT)

Acme — quick ask from your side: can you confirm the final sample CSV by Thursday morning so Grace's numbers are aligned with production? If procurement needs a DocuSign-ready copy of the MAP we can attach that Friday.

Thanks — copying the Drive link again: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-Prep-2027

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Program Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, katie@acme.com
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 18 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: QBR readiness: cascade items, exec asks, and closure plan

Naomi / team / Acme —

Quick status update: I finished the SLA vignette slide deck and pushed it to the Drive (folder: 1QBR-Prep-2027 / SLA-Vignettes). I built contingency text for both Draft A and Draft B SLA language; if Legal confirms Draft B I'll mark the packet for 04/16. Otherwise we'll default to the conservative 04/18 timeline.

Marissa — received the MAP placeholder. If you want me to add a one-paragraph technical summary for procurement to the MAP (brief description of routing/fallback behavior), I can add that and tag it for DocuSign prep.

Grace — I see your note on short-prompt distribution; looks good to me to include the p95 synthetic.

Acme — thanks for the quick turnaround on the CSV earlier today; that helped narrow sample selection.

I'll stand by for Legal's note; Naomi, if you want, I can take on outreach to Legal to clarify Draft A vs B.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Serving Runtime
